observableChecks: At least one contract covers explicit chronology-normalization requests.
At least one negative activation region excludes diagnosis or remediation-only requests.
Required effects preserve observation text, sort valid timestamps, and separate invalid timestamps.
Prohibited effects include invented timestamps and unsupported causal or severity inference.
Responsibility boundaries prohibit files, services, browsing, and other external state.
Blocking unresolved requirements preserve absent decision thresholds, target usage distribution, or required uncertainty rather than inventing them.
Every identifier is derived from observable authored content rather than hidden expected state.
terminalFailureConditions: Missing observable contract or activation boundary
